Record Class PulsarProducerInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.controlpanel.panels.pulsar.PulsarProducerInfo
Record Components:
id - the producer id in the producer registry
topic - the topic
producerName - the producer name
connected - whether the producer is connected to the broker
sent - the messages sent
failed - the messages that could not be sent
public record PulsarProducerInfo(String id, String topic, String producerName, boolean connected, long sent, long failed) extends Record
A Pulsar producer. Internal to the Pulsar panel views.
Since:
2.3.0

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
